# Quackles learning corpus

A descriptive, source-backed production record. Not a controlled benchmark.


- Image observations are not independent experiments.
- Current, shipped, kept and owner-accepted are distinct.
- Keep rates use only explicitly kept/rejected attempts, never unknowns.
- Methods are a curated observational sample, not causal rankings.
- File modification dates are inventory timestamps, not proven creation dates.
- Scores from different judging contexts must not be joined into a progress curve.

# A better vote is not an approval.

None of five one-pass polish candidates cleared the two-reviewer non-regression rule. A current review composite is not a release.

Tension: Small improvements can hide a new regression.

Change: Keep the merge when a vote ties or a regression appears.

Evidence IDs: eval-4110ad3761879822dc87, eval-9dd27752f8a219c33177, eval-efee49ebc209ab903795, eval-fe65777585421bc4cc07, eval-4cb792b52859f84957fd

Primary source: Five-scene merge and polish review, October 14
Source SHA-256: ceb9a16ee20f7a2d93c3a7ae51c9253ccfdbc713e9a42c01b9e0f80daf34d2e2


# Lock the element. Not the whole world.

Day r90 locked the stair geometry while print placement, orb height and lighting remained open.

Tension: A local success can become a false whole-scene sign-off.

Change: Name the exact object and properties that the owner accepted.

Evidence IDs: eval-613be0638bb26157bf90

Primary source: Day step geometry lock, r90
Source SHA-256: 168cb124d687e9d623174ccc7aa0915add95556bab0c4f99bbaef5168b853c73


# Match intent before pixels.

Night changed from literal reference matching to per-element COPY and INTENT constraints, with component review before integration.

Tension: A reference label copied onto different geometry can look wrong.

Change: Judge the brief and the owner locks, not resemblance alone.

Evidence IDs: case-intent-before-pixels

Primary source: Night v2 art-direction brief
Source SHA-256: 9ee99ae630afd1fe7dae7dc2f6191503712c439583e67cfd3987a832b08a63f2


# Change the mechanism, not one more dial.

The Night meta review identified repeated variants retaining the same blocker; its stop rule calls for two genuinely different directions after two focused failures.

Tension: More hair curves or another brightness value need not change the visible form.

Change: Research the mechanism, prove a small coupon, then test on the frozen integrated fixture.

Evidence IDs: case-mechanism-before-tuning

Primary source: Night v2 meta review
Source SHA-256: d7eaad0268446666c186d3509f0730d4108780ce00b7d50faaa89bf614f9a810


# Names are not evidence.

Eye materials with clean-looking names still used photo-projection branches. Blue also had object-linked overrides. Verification inspected effective slots after reopening.

Tension: A correct material name can conceal the wrong shader.

Change: Audit the rendered dependency graph and the saved scene, not only the script.

Evidence IDs: case-effective-state

Primary source: Permanent geometry-owned eye repair
Source SHA-256: 3a1517a29b79da4bfcde1afa44334cf2dd6955a94d88630945955503d07a4952


# Reproduce before taking credit.

Blue changed strongly even in the fresh no-layer baseline. The carry-over report refuses to credit the layer for that baseline drift.

Tension: A striking before/after can measure a renderer change rather than the intended edit.

Change: Use the same capture standard and a no-change control. Keep unlike judge contexts separate.

Evidence IDs: case-reproduce-before-credit

Primary source: Day carry-over layer report
Source SHA-256: aa714f37cf384fd613efba405dbf3e4e17aa2c10af772dc433b075232dc04d83
